name: Stormbringer: Magic Elimination and Piercing Lightning modify Stormbreaker natively (#907, #1302)
contract: #907: Magic Elimination (705668) promises 'Increases the amount of beneficial magic effects purged by your Stormbreaker by 1 and its range by 10 yds.' Its DBC record is two SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) effects on the caster with EffectMiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1, +1) and 5 (SPELLMOD_RANGE, +10), both under EffectSpellClassMask flag96(0,4,0) against SpellFamilyName 22 - an exact match for Stormbreaker's (705669) own SpellFamilyFlags[1]=4. The engine's own spell-modifier system (AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod, SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod, Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers, SpellInfo::GetMaxRange) delivers both halves with no module code or SQL involved, so the modified effect value and range are asserted directly, and a live cast at 25 yd (out of the unmodified 20 yd range, inside the modified 30 yd range) proves the range clause reaches the actual cast pipeline while clearing two fixture beneficial DISPEL_MAGIC auras proves the +1 dispel count reaches Spell::EffectDispel's 'damage' loop. #1302: Piercing Lightning (578302) promises Nature spell penetration scaling with level plus the same +1 Stormbreaker dispel effect via an identical SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 modifier. Its penetration half is SPELL_AURA_MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE (aura 123) with EffectBasePoints -21, EffectDieSides 1, EffectRealPointsPerLevel -1.0, BaseLevel/SpellLevel 20, which SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue resolves to -(casterLevel) for a player caster at or above level 20 - i.e. -80 at level 80 - and AuraEffect::HandleModTargetResistance is a native handler; the amount is asserted with aura_amount. Piercing Lightning contributes no range change, which is asserted by learning it alone (after unlearning Magic Elimination) and confirming spell_max_range returns to 20 while the dispel count still reads 2. Both talents stack to a dispel count of 3. No code exists to fix for either issue; every literal here is derived from the DBC record and the SpellInfo formula, not estimated. The target 'e' is race 5 (Undead) so it is a different faction from 's' (race 1, Human): Stormbreaker's implicit target is TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ENEMY, and two same-faction players with only the pvp flag set are not mutual enemies (Spell::CheckCast rejects the cast with SPELL_FAILED_BAD_TARGETS before the range check ever runs), as confirmed by the first native run of this file. Race 5 / class 2 has a playercreateinfo row (data/sql/updates/pending_db_world/rev_20260917_02_coa_race_class_starts.sql) and is the same cross-faction pattern used by scenarios/primalist-boulder-control.json. The fixture point is also moved from the shared non-hostile spawn (-8917.41, -115.853, 82.3711) to the repo's established non-sanctuary PvP fixture (-9617.06, -288.949, 57.3053, matching primalist-boulder-control.json and the stormbringer-spell-power-scaling-passives-tome-of-lightning fixup): Unit::_IsValidAttackTarget (Unit.cpp:11428-11431) rejects any PvP attack when either participant IsInSanctuary(), independent of faction, and the original spawn sits inside a sanctuary zone.
